sites.name: Ibartegh, the Last Look Back: the Segalen wall (V9)
sites.storm: above the cloud: clear, calm, gold light; bare wind-scoured rock; the fewest objects on the road
sites.story: B21 the last look back (G21_LAST_LOOK, 10 s, move locked); the Segalen stone (never cut)
sites.style: kept stone: a raked parapet round the inside of the crest bend, a dressed stele at its crown
sites.layout:
road leg A (climbing 26 %) ====\            /==== road leg B (falling 16 %)
                                  \  B21   /   (the bend, 4,877 m, the high point)
        rest bay (packed earth) + spur to the carved face
   parapet run A (2 x MV_Foundation, raked) --[STELE]-- parapet run B (2 x MV_Foundation, raked)
   rock (run A dies into it)      outcrop under the stele        rock (run B ends on it)
        footing stones, dust, dead shrubs on the valley side        lower anchor rock
                         ... the valley, the boot point 3.1 km east ...
sites.notes: Story set V9 on the road site S25_LastLookBack (the V1 lane placed nothing here: verify-only). Runs inside V10's load (window B, after B12). The carved lines are a decal (MI_Glyph_V9_Carved from SourceArt/Inscriptions/T_Inscription_V9*), placed by this set's `inscription` step after the settle. The G21 target moves (`glance`). Nothing religious, nothing modern.
